identity.name: MSSM electroweak-baryogenesis neutralino dark matter with light-stop coannihilation
identity.short_description: A restricted MSSM scenario in which a neutralino LSP supplies dark matter while electroweak baryogenesis is supported by CP-violating phases, light charginos and neutralinos, and a mostly right-handed light stop; stop-neutralino coannihilation helps bring the relic density into the observed range.
identity.historical_origin_or_motivation: The paper seeks a common supersymmetric explanation of the baryon asymmetry and dark matter abundance.

lighter chargino close enough for coannihilation in parts of parameter space

annihilation_channels: neutralino self-annihilation to Standard Model and/or Higgs particles
s-channel h0, H0, A0, and Z0 enhanced annihilation
annihilation into gauge-boson pairs for Higgsino-rich neutralinos
interactions.cp_structure: CP-violating phases in the gaugino/Higgsino sector are required for electroweak baryogenesis and modify neutralino masses and couplings.
interactions.flavor_structure: first and second generation sfermions are taken heavy; b to s transitions are discussed as a test of the parameter region.

theory.notes: The paper studies a constrained MSSM parameter region with CP-violating chargino/neutralino phases, a light stop, and R-parity-stabilized neutralino dark matter.

symmetries.stabilizing_mechanism: R-parity is imposed so the neutralino LSP is stable.

mechanisms: thermal neutralino freeze-out
stop-neutralino coannihilation
chargino-neutralino coannihilation
neutralino annihilation through Higgs and Z resonances
abundance_set_by: thermally averaged effective annihilation cross section
mass splitting between neutralino, stop, and chargino
production.notes: The relic abundance is computed by solving a Boltzmann equation for all relevant supersymmetric particles with R-parity conservation.
